primary_score: unchanged upstream verifier pass rate and all-tests-pass reward
knowledge: Agent-authored Argus Engineer/Manager Skills and project Wiki from training only
pi_evolution: Agent-authored executable document-inspection helper installed and used during a training run
deviations: Five-task pilot, not a full benchmark score
Common pinned Python/Pi Docker environment instead of individual upstream images
Four-minute heldout budget, smaller than some upstream task budgets
Direct pytest invocation of unchanged test_outputs.py; no runtime dependency installation
Curated upstream Skills, oracle scripts and verifiers are never mounted in agent runs

amendments_before_heldout.change: Two development cycles on the same two training tasks; retain all first-cycle results and costs.
amendments_before_heldout.reason: Prototype publisher initially mismatched signed Copilot tool-call IDs and excluded validator failures from allowed evidence. Both bridge issues fixed before heldout runs.

pass_rate_definition: passed / (passed + failed); skipped tests reported separately; primary reward remains upstream pytest success
